ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution appearing as localized speckling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white speckling and mottling distributed across both lobes; highest density of white pixel clusters is mapped to the distal lateral regions and the leading edge peripheries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated internal angle of 65 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations present along the entire continuous trailing edge of both lobes, characterized by varying pixel-amplitude peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave sweep originating from the median notch and terminating at the pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of small, circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (rosettes) across the entire ventral surface, particularly concentrated on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the medial-lower region of the left lobe, cutting through the base pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged indentations on the trailing edge of the right lobe, distinct from natural serration patterns, suggesting historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white patch on the distal ventral surface of the right fluke tip.
